body:
Off Stamp's Blueberry Apple Cobbler Off Stamp X-Cube Kit Crystal is designed for adults who want more control than a disposable offers. A rechargeable device plus a compatible pod gives you a setup you can reuse, refill or swap as your preferences change.

Blueberry Apple Cobbler Off Stamp X-Cube Kit Crystal is listed at $19.99 in our Vape Kits range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Vape Kits](/shop/vape-kits/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name Blueberry Apple Cobbler X-Cube Crystal points to bright, juicy berry notes with a natural sweet-tart balance, with soft stone-fruit and apple notes that stay balanced. Flavor is personal, so treat the description as a guide rather than a promise: how a profile tastes depends on your device, how you draw and what you vaped before.

## Specifications
- **Brand:** Off Stamp
- **Category:** Vape Kits
- **Flavor:** Blueberry Apple Cobbler X-Cube Crystal
- **Nicotine strength:** 50mg (5%)
- **Price:** $19.99
- **Ships from:** Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse
- **Age requirement:** 21+ with adult signature on delivery

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Matching replacement pods:** the pods in this range are sold separately, so restocking is straightforward.
- **Rechargeable battery:** charge over USB-C and keep using the same device instead of buying a new one each time.
- **Compact kit design:** keeps the device and pod together in a body that is easy to carry.

### About the strength
This product is listed at 50mg (5%). Compare that figure with what you currently use before you order, remember that nicotine is addictive, and speak to a healthcare professional if you have questions about it.

## Who it suits
Blueberry Apple Cobbler Off Stamp X-Cube Kit Crystal suits adult vapers upgrading from disposables, those who want a reusable device with swappable pods, and gift buyers looking for a complete set that is ready to use.

## Using and caring for it
Charge the device fully before first use with a standard USB-C cable, seat the pod firmly until it clicks, and give a new pod a minute to saturate before you begin. Take short, steady draws, keep the pod connectors clean and dry, and store the kit upright away from heat. Use only the compatible pods listed in the same product range, and never charge a damaged device. Keep all parts away from children and pets.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
Checkout accepts Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, crypto and gift cards. Choosing crypto or a gift card takes 10% off your total, and orders of $200 or more after that discount ship free. A flat $15 fee applies to smaller orders, and the minimum order is $100.

Your parcel leaves our Phoenix Stock Warehouse within 24 to 72 business hours and ships with a tracking number. Adult signature (21+) is required on delivery, as federal PACT Act rules require for vapor products, so please plan to be available or choose an address where an adult can sign.

## Returns and support
If something is wrong with your order, contact us within 30 days and we will help. Unopened items in original packaging can be returned or exchanged, a 15% restocking fee applies to refunds, and refunds go back through the payment method you originally used. Opened or used e-liquid and devices cannot be returned. Our refund policy has the full details. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
